name: pipelines
title: Pipelines
description: Pipelines: visually build durable LLM workflows and run them on Pi. Adds a Pipelines page on the rail where you drag nodes (Input, LLM call, Agent, Prompt, Shell, Code, Branch, Loop, Approval, Sub-pipeline, Output), connect them (fan-out, fan-in, conditional branches), save, and run. Runs are durable: graphs and run state live in documents, and each run is a durable task that checkpoints after every batch of nodes, so a server restart resumes it.
